name: Four Seasons Hotel Washington, DC
insider_take: A polished Georgetown sanctuary where power players unwind just blocks from the nation's most iconic landmarks.
whats_special: This elegant brick façade hotel sits in historic Georgetown, occupying a prime corner that was once home to the city's first Ritz-Carlton. The property features one of DC's most coveted rooftop bars and maintains its own beehives on-site, with honey served at breakfast and used in spa treatments.
pro_tip: Book a Potomac River view room on higher floors for stunning sunset vistas over the waterfront, and time your rooftop visit during cherry blossom season for Instagram-worthy shots with the Washington Monument backdrop.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to the C&O Canal towpath makes for perfect morning jogs, while Georgetown's cobblestone streets offer world-class shopping at brands like Hermès and Louis Vuitton. The nearby Kennedy Center and Watergate complex are within a scenic 10-minute walk along the Potomac.
pros: Prime Georgetown location with upscale shopping and dining nearby
Legendary Four Seasons service and attention to detail
Elegant rooms and suites with luxury amenities
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury Four Seasons properties
Georgetown location may require travel to reach major DC monuments
